recommendations.Content-Security-Policy: Add 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'' to restrict resource origins and mitigate Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data-injection attacks.
recommendations.Strict-Transport-Security: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' to enforce HTTPS and prevent protocol-downgrade and cookie-hijacking attacks.
recommendations.X-Frame-Options: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' (or SAMEORIGIN) to prevent your pages from being embedded in iframes, mitigating clickjacking attacks.
recommendations.X-Content-Type-Options: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to stop browsers from MIME-sniffing responses, preventing content-type confusion attacks.
recommendations.Referrer-Policy: Add 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin' to control how much referrer information is sent, limiting information leakage to third parties.
recommendations.Permissions-Policy: Add 'Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()' to explicitly disable powerful browser features and reduce the attack surface.
